reference.title: Scanner and Metadata
reference.shortdesc: The following configuration fields connect vulnerability scanning, model card metadata, and OCI artifact referrers in Red Hat Quay.

section.p: These settings enable enhanced visibility and security by providing Red Hat Quay with the following options:

ul.li: Integrating with a vulnerability scanner to assess container images for known CVEs.
Rendering AI/ML model metadata through model cards stored in the registry.
Exposing relationships between container artifacts using the Referrers API, aligning with the OCI artifact specification.

section.p: Collectively, these features help improve software supply chain transparency, enforce security policies, and support emerging metadata-driven workflows.
